summary: Dynex Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose Amendment No. 10 to its at-the-market (ATM) distribution agreement with ten sales agents, including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley. The amendment increases the share reserve by 80 million common shares to 301,292,973 total, with 99,326,438 shares remaining available. The shares are offered under an existing S-3 shelf registration statement. No price, premium, or recommendation is stated; the filing is a routine capital-markets update, not a special situation. Investors should monitor the company's ATM usage and common-stock issuance pace.
